entities.name: 1997 Irkutsk Antonov An-124 crash
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On 6 December 1997, a Russian Air Force Antonov An-124-100, en route from Irkutsk Northwest Airport to Cam Ranh Air Base in Vietnam, crashed in a residential area after takeoff from the airport.
